classes.instruction: Start neutral. At GO, beckon towards yourself with your index finger twice. Keep the wrist reasonably steady. Then return to neutral.
Start neutral. At GO, deliberately point down: index extended, thumb and middle bent. Hold briefly, then return.
Start neutral. At GO, present an upward-facing open palm with the three measured fingers extended. Hold briefly, then return.
Start neutral. At GO, point with the index finger and turn the pointed hand clockwise once, as seen by you looking at your hand. Use a comfortable rotation, then return.

Start neutral. At GO, form a finger gun: index and thumb extended, middle bent. Hold briefly, then return. This is the default detailed-proposal pose; change this definition if your team agrees another thumb pose.

Before GO, loosely hold an imaginary ball, not a tight fist. At GO, perform one overhand throw: swing from above/behind the shoulder and extend the fingers naturally to release the imaginary ball. Keep the hand open briefly after release, then return.

Before GO, loosely hold an imaginary ball near the hip, not a tight fist. At GO, perform one underhand throw: swing forward from below and extend the fingers naturally to release the imaginary ball. Keep the hand open briefly after release, then return.

variants.instruction: Keep a relaxed hand still; perform no command gesture.
At GO, gently make a fist and reopen it while keeping the wrist still. Do not throw.
At GO, make an overhand throw-like arm swing while keeping a loose ball grip. Deliberately do not release the fingers.
At GO, make an underhand throw-like arm swing while keeping a loose ball grip. Deliberately do not release the fingers.
At GO, move an already-open hand casually. Do not perform a deliberate throw or any command pose.
At GO, casually adjust your sleeve or move your arm as in ordinary use. Avoid deliberately performing a command gesture.
